items.t: Named clusters: Stevenson Road beside Sardis Park, Keith Wilson Road in south Sardis, Collins Drive, Promontory Road, and Garrison Crossing around Tamihi Way.
Vedder Road divides them: Sardis Park, Collins Drive and Promontory east; Keith Wilson Road west.
Villas at Sardis Park, 45819 Stevenson Road: named in City council minutes (residents' petition).
Iron Horse rowhomes, 46211 Promontory Road: named in the developer's own project brochure.
Garrison Crossing: CD-9 sets townhouses to R4 standards (site 1,200 square metres, width 30 metres) and rowhouses to a 170-square-metre minimum lot.

blocks.text: Sardis Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Sardis sites sit on the Vedder River alluvial fan, covered by an OCP development permit area, so drainage and flood design are reviewed.
Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519: 75-metre setback from the Vedder River's natural boundary, plus fan flood construction levels.

blocks.text: Sardis Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Sardis Park, 6898 School Lane, beside the Villas: a former gravel pit with a pond and 655-metre loop.
Watson Glen Park was a gravel pit; its fill built the Vedder Road Cottonwood overpass.
Sardis Sports Complex, 5725 Tyson Road (three rinks), and Sardis Library, 5819 Tyson Road.
Sardis Secondary's 400-seat addition opened August 2026 at 45460 Stevenson Road, removing 11 portables.
Cheam Leisure Centre, 45501 Market Way, serves the Garrison Crossing cluster.

blocks.text: Sardis Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Townhouse rezoning, 44877 Keith Wilson Road: application RZ001689, applicant Alex Mochtchenkov, R1-A to R4. STATUS: public hearing held December 2, 2025, read 2026-11-03; adoption and unit count not stated.
Townhouse development, 45925 Collins Drive: reviewed by the Design Review Advisory Committee under DP002051. STATUS: design review stage, read 2026-11-03; developer and unit count not stated.
Andmar, beside the Thomas Road townhomes: see sardis-condos-for-sale.
City-wide 2026 rates and charges apply to Sardis strata on City land: see chilliwack-houses-for-sale.
Lots rezoned to R4, such as 44877 Keith Wilson Road, attract development cost charges per its housing target report.
Route 54 Promontory: Cottonwood Mall via Stevenson, Tyson and Watson Roads to Promontory.

blocks.text: Sardis Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check a site against the Vedder fan permit area and Bylaw No. 4519 before treating a complex's age as proof of flood compliance.
Promontory complexes carry slope risk: Development Permit Area 2 required geotechnical reports; the depreciation report shows slope and drainage works.

faq.a: Yes. Garrison Crossing uses one comprehensive zone, CD-9, instead of R4. Townhouses there must meet R4 standards — 1,200-square-metre site, 30-metre width — while rowhouses have a 170-square-metre minimum lot and detached houses 240. The mix was set when the neighbourhood was zoned, not lot by lot.

A lot at 44877 Keith Wilson Road is being rezoned from R1-A to R4 (Low Density Multi-Unit Residential) for a future townhouse development, under application RZ001689, applicant Alex Mochtchenkov, per the City's own hearing notice; the hearing was December 2, 2025.
faq.q: What is happening on Keith Wilson Road?

faq.a: It depends on the side of Sardis. The district locator for 45170 South Sumas Road returned Tyson Elementary, Vedder Middle and Sardis Secondary; a Promontory complex falls toward Promontory Heights Elementary and G.W. Graham Secondary (sample: 46200 Stoneview Drive). Run the civic address.
faq.q: Which schools does a Sardis townhome feed?

faq.a: Promontory ones do. The City designates hillside neighbourhoods including Promontory as Wildlife Issue Areas under the Solid Waste Management Bylaw: wildlife-resistant carts, nothing at the curb before 5:00 a.m., removal by 10:00 p.m. Stevenson and Tyson Road complexes are outside the designated areas.
